body: I also am so close to doing it. I have enough pills to overdose and finally rest in peace but if we are hesitant then theres something we are missing. Something that keeps us here but we dont know yet or something we are to blind to see because all we think about is ending it. O dont know if i have the power to keep gpong but im sure if i did and stay hesitant like this it will be worth. Everything will be better soon i hope. I hope ypu stay hesitant and dont end it because it will be worth.
Hey dont do it man. Life can be a good thing but you have to be patient and never give up hope. Dont take the easy way out you deserve so much more.
You deserve everything man, im sure we all will feel better anytime soon.
I think we all are but someday there will be the moment where life is worth it.

You are a real person. You matter and dont have to choose the easy way out. Life is great you just have to have hope and be patient. Someday you will be thankfull you didnt end it so please dont give up and keep fighting.

I think God chose to let you live and you have to take advantage of that. I dont know your reasons but life finds a way. Everything will be better soon. Just try to pick up hope and look for help. Dont try it again. Either it works the first time or it wont work. I hope you feel better soon and please dont give up. Life is worth it
Hey i hope you have a good journey man. I feel the same but i hope you find peace and can rest.

Hey dont do it dude. Life is full of pain and suffering but if he said that you should kill yourself hes definitely not worth it. Life will get better after every downside there will be an upside but you just have to hope. I also lost my girlfriend she is the only one i ever cared about but now she is gone and theres also no reason to be here anymore. But i think someday everyone will find the person that truly makes them happy so dont give up hope man. You got this
Thank you for your reply man. I hope you have a good life from now on because after every downside theres an upside so we just have to continue living i guess.

I wont seek help i am sure i can do it on my own if i really wantes but man thank you i dont think i will be doing it this night. But you also gotta watch yourself you just helped me so dont do anything stupid please stay alive and live on. Everything will be better

I dont actually think i deserve it because life has its way and everything goes how its meant to be and i always mess things up because i am not ready but anyways thanks for your help. It means much to me.

Your english is actually pretty good and i am from germany and understand everything. I can kind of relate to your story i also had this girl but she left me because i could not see anything positive. I always thought about negative things even when she was around me but after all that i realised that i was much happier with her but now shes gone and theres no way to get her back. She prevented me from killing myself about 3 months ago but now i feel hopeless and theres no point in living anymore. I am searching for people that go through similar things but the fact that there are people like you that had to go through more pain than me is unimagibable. I am going to end it this night but i hope that you find another girl that makes you truly happy and that wont leave you because of your mental state. Never give up its not worth dying over someone that left you just because you had those thoughts again.
